name: localstack-app-inspector
description: Query and manage App Inspector traces, spans, and events to review deployed LocalStack applications

action.description: The App Inspector action to perform. Typical debugging flow: get-status, set-status to enabled if needed, run AWS workload, list-traces, list-spans for a trace, then list-events or list-iam-events for a span.

status.description: Status to set. Required for set-status. Use enabled before running a workload you want to inspect.

trace_id.description: Trace ID. Required for get-trace, list-spans, get-span, delete-spans, list-events, get-event, and list-iam-events. For list-spans/list-events/list-iam-events, use '*' to query across all traces.

span_id.description: Span ID. Required for get-span, list-events, get-event, and list-iam-events. For list-events/list-iam-events, use '*' to query across all spans.

trace_ids.description: Trace IDs to delete for delete-traces. Omit to delete all traces.

span_ids.description: Span IDs to delete for delete-spans. Omit to delete all spans in the trace scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000)

pagination_token.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

service_name.description: Filter traces or spans by AWS service name, e.g. lambda, s3, sqs.

account_id.description: Filter traces or spans by LocalStack AWS account ID.

arn.description: Filter traces or spans by resource ARN. This value is not sent to analytics.

parent_span_id.description: Filter traces or spans by parent span ID.

status_code.description: Filter traces or spans by status code.

start_time_unix_nano.description: Filter traces or spans by start timestamp in Unix nanoseconds.

end_time_unix_nano.description: Filter traces or spans by end timestamp in Unix nanoseconds.

version.description: Filter traces or spans by App Inspector schema version.

event_type.description: Filter events by event type, e.g. iam.policy_evaluation.
